newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Caltex sees small rise in Philippine market share.
newsitem.headline: Caltex sees small rise in Philippine market share.

text.p: Caltex (Philippines) Inc, a unit of Caltex Petroleum Corp, sees a "marginal increase" in market share despite its newly-launched $50 million program to change its image in the Philippines.

"We are not looking for a dramatic growth in market share but more of retention recognizing that new entrants will be coming in with the deregulation of the oil sector by March next year," William Tiffany, president of Caltex Philippines Inc said on Thursday.
Caltex chairman David Law-Smith told a news conference that in Singapore, the firm's newly designed retail stations had posted a 40 percent increase in throughput.

Tiffany added that the new image of Caltex will help to "marginally grow our market share." Of the three oil refiners in the country, Caltex has the least market share at 24.5 percent based on industry figures.
The $50-million investment in the Philippines is part of an Asia-wide $500 million program to change the brand image of Caltex, a joint venture of Chevron Corp and Texaco Inc.
